ad_intro:
Why a performance-marketing audit includes the website: Meta does not make you money - the click does. CPL is paid on the ad; the conversion happens on the landing page, the form, WhatsApp speed-to-lead and the proof. Oorjan is the rare case where the product page is good and the demand layer is missing: a real pincode-based estimator, five priced kit tiers, bank financing - and not one rupee of PM Surya Ghar anywhere, no WhatsApp, and a 404 in the main menu.

Oorjan Cleantech Pvt Ltd, founded 2014 in Mumbai by Gautam Das (Co-founder & CEO, ex-Citi 15+ yrs, IIT Bombay / ISB) with Roli Gupta and Hrishikesh Deshpande; operations began 2016. Raised $450,000 seed led by Globevestor. Offices Mumbai, Pune, Silvassa, Bengaluru, Patna; operational across 14 states. ET Energy World (Nov 2022): solar projects worth ~$100 mn / ~150 MW deployed in 4 years; 1,500+ customers as of 2021 with a stated goal of 10,000. Gautam Das was named CEO of the Year in the solar sector (ET Now / World CSR, Feb 2020). Day-1 file 14 Sep 2026: 6/10, ~6 ads, Lead Form dest, under Rs.1 L/mo est., pitch_fit HIGH.

Live check 14 Sep 2026: the site's conversion spine is genuinely good - a 'Design Your System' estimator segmented Residential / Commercial / Society taking pincode, average monthly bill and roof area, plus a Solar Kits page with five on-grid tiers (2, 3, 5, 7, 10 kWp) listing panel count, inverter size and BoS, each with a 'Check Pricing/Details' path and a tree-equivalent impact stat. Financing is real: direct agreements with nationalised banks, IDBI's only Indian solar-loan partner, PPA financing for industrial customers, and a Loan / PAYG structure. Monitoring runs through an Oorjan iOS/Android app. Panel tiers are named honestly - Premium (Vikram Solar, Waaree, RenewSys, REC) vs Economy (PV Powertech, GoldiGreen, Zytech, HHV), inverters Fronius/Delta/SMA vs Growatt/K-Star.

What is broken: a grep of the homepage returns zero matches for 'subsidy', 'Surya Ghar' or 'WhatsApp'. The 'User Stories' link in the main navigation returns 'Oops! Could not find that page' - a 404 on the social-proof page, in the nav, on a site running ads. The trust wall is an MNRE channel-partner certificate from 2016, a 2015 solar-leaders award and a 2016 women-led-startup award; the news feed's most recent item is from Mar 2024. The FAQ still says 'India does not support this yet' about net metering.

Day-1 leak, confirmed: strong reviews and 1,500+ installs that never appear in creatives. Ad counts are Day-1 estimates. Never promise subsidy approval.
ad_intelligence: Ad Library is 30% of the leak. The other 70%: (1) does the landing match the hook, (2) can they WhatsApp in under 5 minutes, (3) is there proof a neighbour installed, (4) is the form short, (5) does tracking fire on estimator/enquire not just PageView. Oorjan passes (4) - the estimator is 3 fields - and fails (1), (2) and (3) outright. The estimator is the best asset in the funnel and almost no paid traffic is being sent to it.

Meta (FB+IG) at low volume - ~6 creatives, under Rs.1 L/mo. Google Search/PMax on 'solar panel price Mumbai', 'housing society solar', 'solar loan'. Owned: oorjan.com + blog.oorjan.com + the Oorjan monitoring app. Verify both Meta Ad Library India and Google Ads Transparency (oorjan.com) before quoting any number. At this spend level the account is a test budget, not a scaled programme.

~6 creatives by Day-1 signature - the lowest count in the Day-1 HIGH cohort. That is the opportunity: the funnel assets (estimator, kits, financing) already exist and are barely being fed. Do not quote 6 as a hard number; confirm live.

Five on-grid kits: 2 kWp (4 panels / 3 kW inverter), 3 kWp (6 / 3 kW), 5 kWp (10 / 5 kW), 7 kWp (13 / 8 kW), 10 kWp (19 / 10 kW), all Premium BoS with an optional structure kit charged separately. Premium brands Vikram Solar, Waaree, RenewSys, REC with Fronius/Delta/SMA inverters; Economy tier PV Powertech, GoldiGreen, Zytech, HHV with Growatt/K-Star. Segments: Residential, Commercial, Society - society rooftop is a genuine Mumbai niche (100 kWp Mahavir Universe Phoenix, Bhandup, ~Rs.20 lakh/yr saved).

Ad -> oorjan.com -> 'Design Your System' (Residential / Commercial / Society + pincode + monthly bill + roof area) -> /estimator 'Design and Price'. No WhatsApp entry point anywhere on the site. 'User Stories' in the primary nav 404s. Financing page is a bare three-header stub (Financing Requests / Loan / PAYG) with no EMI figure, no interest rate and no application path. No city landing pages despite 14 states and five offices.
Subsidy gap - the single biggest finding

PM Surya Ghar is at 50.06 lakh homes, 16,185 MW and Rs.28,024 Cr disbursed by DBT, with ~16,328 installs a day and scheme loans at 5.75% (MNRE, Aug 2026). The word 'subsidy' does not appear on Oorjan's homepage. A company whose entire differentiator is financing is silent on the largest consumer financing event in Indian solar history. Their MNRE credential is real but dated 2016.
findings: The word 'subsidy' does not exist on your website (verified 14 Sep 2026). A grep of oorjan.com returns zero matches for 'subsidy', 'Surya Ghar' or 'WhatsApp'. PM Surya Ghar has reached 50.06 lakh homes and 16,185 MW, paid out Rs.28,024 Cr by DBT and offers 5.75% scheme loans - it is the reason Indian homeowners are searching at all in 2026. Oorjan's entire brand thesis is easy financing, and the biggest financing story in the category is absent from the site and the ads. Put the exact slabs (Rs.30,000 / Rs.60,000 / Rs.78,000) next to your IDBI loan and PAYG options, with 'MNRE process; Oorjan does not approve subsidy'.

There is a 404 in your main navigation - on the social-proof page. 'User Stories' appears in both the desktop and mobile menus and returns 'Oops! Could not find that page.' That is the page a homeowner clicks after the estimator, and it is the exact page the Day-1 leak says is missing from your creatives. Fix the route, then populate it with the installs you already have: 1,500+ customers, 150 MW deployed, and the 100 kWp Mahavir Universe Phoenix society job in Bhandup saving ~Rs.20 lakh a year.

Day-1 leak confirmed: strong proof, invisible in the funnel. Reviews, 14 states, five offices, a named CEO-of-the-Year founder, and a $100 mn / 150 MW deployment record - none of it is in the creative, and the on-site trust wall is an MNRE certificate from 2016, an award from 2015 and another from 2016. The newest item in the news feed is March 2024. For a category where the buyer's core fear is 'will this company still exist when my net meter arrives', a proof wall that stops a decade ago actively harms conversion.

No WhatsApp at all - in a WhatsApp-first category. There is no chat entry point anywhere on the site. Every serious competitor answers 'kitna kharcha hoga?' on WhatsApp within minutes. The estimator is excellent, but it asks a cold visitor to commit to a full design flow with no low-friction alternative. Add click-to-WhatsApp as the secondary CTA on every page and as the primary CTA on the ads themselves; speed-to-lead under five minutes is the single largest CPL lever in Indian residential solar.

Your best asset is starved of traffic. The 'Design Your System' estimator (Residential / Commercial / Society, pincode, monthly bill, roof area) and five priced kit tiers are better than what most Day-1 competitors have - and the account is running only ~6 creatives at under Rs.1 L/mo. This is the inverse of the usual problem: the conversion machine exists and nobody is being sent to it. Fire a distinct pixel event on estimator-start and estimator-complete, then scale spend against that event rather than PageView.

The financing page - your differentiator - is an empty stub. /financing renders three headers: 'Financing Requests', 'Loan', 'PAYG'. No interest rate, no EMI example, no tenure, no application form, despite direct nationalised-bank agreements and being IDBI's only Indian solar-loan partner. Also fix the FAQ line that says of net metering 'India does not support this yet' - it is factually wrong in 2026 and it is on a page prospects read before buying.
competitors: City pages, 15k+ Google ratings, subsidy rupees above the fold, heavy install UGC, WhatsApp-first.

Balance-sheet trust, exact CFA slabs per SKU, DISCOM familiarity, DCR/ALMM clarity.
You install Waaree, Vikram and REC panels - borrow that trust explicitly in the creative instead of hiding it in an FAQ table.
Society-committee references, per-flat savings maths, fast site visits.

Build a dedicated Housing Society landing page and campaign - committee-facing maths, per-flat savings, the Bhandup case study, a site-visit scheduler - plus city pages for Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Patna and Silvassa where you already have offices. Refresh the trust wall from 2015-2016 awards to 150 MW / $100 mn deployed / 14 states / 1,500+ customers, and fix the FAQ's incorrect net-metering line. Shoot 15 terrace and society Reels in Marathi/Hindi/English. Audiences: estimator abandoners, kit-page viewers, 50% video viewers - 60-day windows.
